lines.scenario: 15-minute two-way all-day service on Lakeshore West, Lakeshore East, Kitchener, Barrie, Stouffville corridors. Modeled as wait-per-boarding on GO edges reduced from 4 to 2 minutes (documented scenario, not a capacity model).

meta.note: Station coordinates are approximate (nearest major intersection, +/-300m) from published Metrolinx alignments; Eglinton West stations were corrected 2026-10-09 against geocoded Eglinton Ave W intersections and the TTC GTFS Mount Dennis LRT platform (stop 16067). Travel times are modeled: inter-station distance / assumed average speed + dwell. Budgets are publicly reported figures with source and date; definitions vary (build-only vs build+operate) and are labeled per line.
